title: Plan runner judge result
description: What the read-only judge session (scripts/plan-runner/judge-prompt.md) ends with. The driver logs the counts per severity and keeps the file; nothing is acted on. Protocol: scripts/plan-runner/benchmark.md.

verdict.description: gaps: at least one high finding. cannot_judge: the diff or the spec could not be read well enough to grade.

findings.description: Only findings confirmed against the code.

testsAdequate.description: Whether the step's non-trivial logic has tests and no test was removed without cause.
